description: Byte patterns BeamLS.asi searches for in GTA5.exe's code (after it is unpacked in memory). One row per pattern; each generates one entry in gta/src/gen/patterns.hpp. Every resolve is read as a RIP-relative 32-bit displacement at the given offset (target = address after the 4 bytes + displacement). All rows need confirming on each supported build in the running game; BeamLS.log lists what each pattern found.

columns.purpose: What the code at the match does
columns.resolves: [[name, offset of the rel32 from the match start], ...]

rows.purpose: Script program load: lea rcx, [native registration table]; mov rdx, [native hash]; call GetNativeHandler(table, hash); test rax, rax
rows.source: Public GTA V script-hook projects (BigBaseV2 lineage); recalled, not checked against build 3889
